propositions: docs/event-schema.md statically enumerates six LINK relations and omits the supported caused_by relation, which is present in src/rebar/graph/_links.py:CANONICAL_RELATIONS as the seventh canonical directional, non-blocking, non-cycle-inducing relation.

The maintained relation inventory in docs/event-schema.md drifted from the cited source CANONICAL_RELATIONS due to manual duplication: commit 901241b218 added caused_by to code but did not edit event-schema.md; commit 693a6bf412 later rewrote that row and retained only six relations.
A documentation contract test must parse the event-schema LINK/UNLINK row and enforce set equality with CANONICAL_RELATIONS to prevent future omissions.
The caused_by relation must be documented in event-schema.md with explicit semantics stating it is directional, non-blocking, and non-cycle-inducing.
